title: Pay Exception Control | Payroll Administration | BackOfficeFleet
description: Pay exception control for trucking payroll support teams reviewing detention, accessorials, deductions, reimbursements, approvals, and packet records.
html:
Payroll Administration / Pay Exception Control

Turn pay exceptions into reviewable support records.

When a driver, contractor, or owner asks about pay, the office should see the reason, related load, document support, approval status, and next owner without searching through email.

Payroll AdministrationSettlements

Exception status

Every exception needs a reason code and owner.

Ready, review, blocked, corrected, or escalated should be clear before payroll follow-up continues.

Support record

Group load, receipt, rate, approval, and note.

Detention, lumper, stop pay, reimbursement, claim hold, deduction, or correction request stays tied to the source record.

Resolution path

Assign the next action.

Dispatch, settlement support, finance, HR, safety, driver manager, or leadership owns the next step.
